components.content: Live webcam shots as of 18-04-2025 at 12:00 UTC

items.description: An aerial view looking down on older industrial complex buildings. The main building is white with many windows and pipes running up the walls.

An aerial view of old broken buildings. Nature has begun to take root in the rooftops. A portion of the middle building's roof has collapsed inward. In the distant haze you can make out a far away city.
A street view of a downtown city. Prominently in photo are skyscrapers and a domed building
